headline: The bank KeyBanc lowered its rating on Workday because it doubts the software company's AI products will add much revenue soon.
score_reason: Single analyst downgrade of one software firm; useful as a sign of AI doubts but narrow.
importance_line: Workday shareholders feel it first, then the HR and finance teams that use its software, as a sign that AI excitement may take longer to turn into sales, though this is one analyst's view and Barchart's consensus rating remains Moderate Buy.
summary: Barchart reports that KeyBanc analyst Jason Celino downgraded Workday, a maker of HR and finance software, to Sector Weight, saying that customer enthusiasm at the company's Workday Rising conference does not show when new AI products will add meaningfully to revenue. Celino also thinks companies may give HR technology lower priority as they pay for more immediate AI projects, and Workday shares slipped on Friday after rising about 68% since late June.
notes: investing.com original blocked (403); Barchart's article on the same downgrade read on Yahoo Finance, so Barchart is credited and the Yahoo link is where the text was read.
